#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, B;
    cin >> n >> B;
    
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }
    
    int even = 0, odd = 0;
    vector<int> dp;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (a[i] % 2 == 0)
            even++;
        else
            odd++;
        if (even == odd && i < n - 1)
            dp.push_back(abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]));
    }
    
    sort(dp.begin(), dp.end());
    int ans = 0;
    for (int x : dp) {
        if (B < x) break;
        ans++;
        B -= x;
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
